name: VRI Ray Advancement
definition: Advances a Volume Ray Intersection (VRI) state machine to the next leaf intersection by managing a hierarchical traversal of I2 nodes, I1 nodes, and leaf voxels using DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) stepping.
summary: VRI Ray Advancement advances a volume ray intersection state machine through a three-level hierarchical traversal, distinguishing itself by explicitly separating the process into draining I1 DDAs, stepping I2 DDAs, and advancing root entries.
